overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a single commissioner's comment during open commissioner comments was not commission deliberation, but reminded the commission to list chair-anticipated topics in notices with specificity.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the golf commission deliberated on a topic missing from the June 22 and July 6, 2010 meeting notices when a commissioner addressed a member of the public during a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: It appears that at the July 6, 2010 meeting there was no discussion by the Commission of a topic related to Ms. LeBlanc's letter, but rather a comment was made during an open comment period by a single commissioner.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
